map.从 HTML 片段中抽出所有标签名或指定标签，统计出现次数并去重，便于检查页面结: Pulls all tag names or a specific tag out of an HTML fragment, counts occurrences, and deduplicates them, making it easy to inspect page structure, clean up redundant tags, or verify template markup.
map.分析页面结构：列出文档中所有标签名及出现次数，快速了解骨架。: Analyze page structure: list every tag name and its occurrence count to grasp the skeleton quickly.
map.抽取特定标签：如把所有 <a href>、<img src> 摘出做资源盘点。: Extract specific tags: for example, pull out all and tags for a resource inventory.
map.模板审查：检查是否有未闭合或滥用标签。: Template review: check for unclosed or overused tags.
map.：粘贴一段 HTML，工具列出「div×12、a×5、img×3」并导出所有 <: : paste an HTML snippet and the tool lists "div×12, a×5, img×3" and exports the href list of every <a>, making it easy to check for dead links or outbound links.
map.按文档顺序列出标签，嵌套关系需结合缩进/层级视图；本工具偏「标签清单」，结构性分: Tags are listed in document order, and nesting relationships need the indentation or hierarchy view; this tool leans toward a "tag inventory", so pair it with a DOM tool for structural analysis.
map.默认统计所有 <...> 形态；如需排除 <script>/<style> 内示: All <...> forms are counted by default; to exclude examples inside <script>/<style>, turn on the "body tags only" filter.
